children: Overview
Singapore data center REIT reported nine-month gross revenue of SGD 365.3 mln
Distribution per Unit (DPU) was 8.571 cents in 9M 2026, versus 7.670 cents in 9M 2025, a 11.7% change.
Outlook
Gore Hill Data Centre revenue is set to more than double as new contracts commence from end-2026
Keppel DC Singapore 8 asset enhancement initiative remains on track for completion in H2 2027
Keppel DC REIT targets a 50% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2035 from a 2025 baseline
Result Drivers
ORGANIC GROWTH AND TOKYO 3 – Higher 9M NPI was driven by positive rental reversions and escalations and the Tokyo Data Centre 3 acquisition, partly offset by asset exits and Cardiff vacancy
ACQUISITION FINANCING COSTS – Higher finance costs from acquisition loans and Keppel DC Singapore 7 and 8 lease-extension consideration partly offset distributable income and DPU growth for 9M
PORTFOLIO REVERSION – Portfolio reversion reached about 14% in 9M, while contracted power capacity rose to about 96%, indicating strong leasing activity
